Dialogs.Dialog: Haven't your texts been coming less often lately？
I'm saying it because they have.
How come you barely text me lately？
What, are you trying to say I'm lying？
(She's in a bit of a bad mood...)
Hey... Can I ask you something？
You haven't been texting me much lately. Why？
Really...？ I wasn't trying not to or anything.
I just wondered if it meant you aren't thinking about me much.
Hey... I feel like we haven't been kissing as much lately.
Do you want me to kiss you？
Idiot! That's not what I meant.
(Maybe I haven't been showing her enough affection...)
You barely kiss me lately. What's that about？
What's it about...? It doesn't really mean anything...
Oh, I see... So it's just whatever to you.
What's wrong？ Why the gloomy face？
Well... You haven't been kissing me lately... so I was just wondering why.
There's nothing to worry about. It's not like we're fighting or anything.
Yeah, but... you still haven't been kissing me.
Yeah, it did. Why do you keep standing me up on dates lately？
I was looking forward to them, so it really hurts, you know. Do you get that？
(Hmm, I guess I made her a little mad.)
Why do you keep standing me up？ Things like that have been happening a lot lately.
Playing dumb won't work! It actually... really hurts, you know.
Well... You've been standing me up on dates a lot lately, so it's been bothering me.
It's not like you don't want to go out with me anymore, right？
(I really shouldn't be making her feel insecure...)
Why did you just leave me alone on our last date？ I really hate that.
Dodging the question won't work. Just... don't do it again, okay？
(Guess she really is a little mad...)
You left me all alone on our last date, remember？ I hate it when you do that.
▲小早川＊▲! What's up, what is it？
I'm mad at you. Because you left me on my own during our last date.
(Oh, that... Looks like it's bothering her a bit.)
It's not like it's bothering me or anything, but... can I ask you something？
We haven't been seeing each other as much lately. ...Why？
It's not like I'm doing it on purpose...
So it just couldn't be helped？ Well... if that's all, it's fine.
Hey... We haven't really been seeing each other much lately, have we？
Yes, it is. Don't you get lonely？
(I need to make more time to see her...)
Hey... Why haven't we been seeing each other as much lately？
Well, notice, geez. I've been pretty lonely, you know.
(I should try not to let her get too lonely.)
What is it？ You seem kinda down...
Anyway, who was that earlier？ You two looked pretty close. Not that you have to tell me if you don't want to...
(Oh, so that's what this is about...)
That girl you were having such a nice chat with earlier... What is she to you？
What is she to me？ She's just a friend.
Hmm. Well then... I guess that makes me 'just' your girlfriend.
Hey... You don't have to say anything if you don't want to, but...
About that girl you were getting along so well with...
Oh, earlier？ We were just talking normally. She's just a friend.
Really？ Well, okay then... I just got a little worried.
Mmm... I think I'll be fine if I sleep for a day.
You sure？ Don't push yourself too hard.
Worried about me？ Even though you're the one who gave it to me... Hehe.
Not good, obviously... Just kidding. A day of sleep and I'll be fine in no time.
I hope so... Did I end up giving you that cold？
Don't flatter yourself. Well... it probably is your cold, though.
Want to give it back to me？
Not great, but I think I'll be fine if I rest for a day.
Take it easy and get some rest. I might be the one who gave you that cold...
You think...？ If it's your cold, I might actually be kind of glad.
Want to pass it to me again？
Want to give it to me again？ You might get better faster that way.
No way. If you catch a cold, nursing you back to health would be a pain.
Want to give it back to me？ You don't have to hold back.
Idiot. If I did that, I'd end up having to take care of you.
Want to pass it to me again？ I'll take responsibility and take it off your hands.
Hehe... That's sweet, but then we'd never be able to go on a date.
I'm sorry. I should've been more careful.
You're worrying too much. I'll be back on my feet in no time.
I really feel bad about this...
Drop it already. All you need to do is stay healthy and take care of me.
I should've been more careful. That's on me.
Don't beat yourself up over it. I should've been more careful about not catching it, too.
Here, I sliced up some apple. Want some？
Thanks, how thoughtful of you. While you're at it, why don't you feed me？
Thanks for coming to check on me. I was actually... really happy. I feel like I'm gonna get better a lot faster now.
Glad to hear it. Well, I'll head home now... Call me if you need anything, okay？
Yeah, well, it wasn't a big deal to begin with.
Sorry I couldn't come visit you.
Don't worry about it. If you'd come over... I probably wouldn't have gotten any sleep anyway.
Are you back to normal already？
It was just a little cold. I slept it right off.
That's good. Still... sorry I missed the chance to come check on you.
Whatever. It would've been a pain if you came to visit and caught it from me.
Did you get over your cold？
Yeah, I'm fine now! Sorry for making you worry.
I'm the one who should apologize. I didn't even come check on you while you were sick... I'm sorry.
It's fine. If you'd come over, my heart would've been racing too much to get any rest anyway.
(...I still feel pretty bad about it.)
Didn't you get over your cold faster than expected？
Yeah. Maybe because a certain someone took a little of it off my hands.
Why is your face turning red？ ...Hehe.
Are you over your cold already？
Yeah. I think it cleared up faster than I expected.
Guess my kiss did the trick.
Idiot! ...I can't believe you can just say stuff like that with a straight face.
You look like you're feeling all better.
Yeah, looks like I bounced back faster than planned. Maybe it's thanks to your kiss？
Oh, your face is red. Got a fever？ Just kidding... Hehe.
A little sluggish, but it's nothing serious.
You know how they say a cold goes away faster if you pass it on to someone？
How are you holding up？ Feeling bad？
Not that bad. I think I'll be fine soon if I just take it easy.
Want me to take that cold off your hands？
I can't let you do that.
It's nothing to worry that much about. I'll be fine after some sleep.
They say you get over a cold faster if you give it to someone else, right？ I wonder if that's true.
Try it... on me？ ...I mean, I don't mind.
I don't mind, sure. That means what I think it means... right？
Wait, so you mean... doing that, right？ Of course I don't mind, though...
There you go saying stuff like that again... Not that I mind.
Oh, alright. You better get well soon, okay？
Of course I will. Just make sure you get better soon, okay？
Yeah, I think it's starting to work.
Honestly... you're too much. If this puts me in bed, you'd better take good care of me.
Hmm, I think I'm starting to feel better already...
There's no way it kicks in that fast. If I catch a cold, you're taking responsibility.
If I catch your cold, you'll take care of me, right？
(Wait, could she actually catch it...? No way.)
Yeah, I think it's going to work this time too.
Honestly... What are you gonna do if I catch a cold？
I'll take care of you if that happens.
There. I took it off your hands for you.
Thanks. I think it'll do the trick.
I'm sure you know, but I'll expect the same when it's my turn.
I'm all good on my end. Now I just hope you don't catch it, ▲小早川＊▲.
I wouldn't mind catching it. You'd be extra nice to me, wouldn't you？
No way. You came all this way to check on me—I can't get you sick.
That's obviously a myth. Don't tell me you actually believe it？
Hey, I tried making some rice porridge... Want some？
Thanks for today, ▲小早川＊▲. I'm feeling a lot better now because of you.
Good. Well, I'll head home now, but call me if you need anything. Bye.
Yeah, seems it was just a mild cold. I'm totally fine now.
Thank goodness... I'm glad it wasn't anything serious.
You don't have to worry so much about me. Thanks.
Yeah, I'm fine now. Were you worried about me？
Well, believe it or not, yeah.
Good. When you're under the weather, it brings me down too.
Thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲, I'm completely back to normal.
Huh. Maybe that whole thing wasn't just superstition after all.
Maybe... More importantly, did you catch my cold, ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, so you actually do worry about me？ I'm fine, seriously.
Thanks for coming to see me. I'm all better now.
Good for you. Think maybe you have me to thank for that？
Definitely. I'll be counting on you next time, too.
Thanks for visiting me the other day. As you can see, I'm all better.
I'm glad. Maybe... that kiss worked？
Could be. Wait, you didn't catch my cold, did you, ▲小早川＊▲？
No, I was fine. Though if I had caught it, you could've nursed me back to health... Hehe.
(▲小早川＊▲ is acting kind of strange...)
Um, how do I put this...
Uh... Well, it's not really something I need to make a big deal of saying, but...
I mean... that's how I feel about you, right？ Technically.
Wait, no, that's not what I...
(Hm？ Something seems a little different about ▲小早川＊▲...)
Well... Are you mad at me or something？
Then what's been going on with you...？
It's a little late for this, I know, I just got nervous...
I wanted to tell you that I love you...
I kind of want you to spoil me.
Is it okay if I get a little clingy？
That's why I want you to spoil me.
What were you trying to tell me, anyway？
I forgot... Whatever, I got what I came for.
(I guess even ▲小早川＊▲ gets this bold sometimes...)
That I love you... Did that get across？
(It's rare to see ▲小早川＊▲ be this forward...)
Hehe, I got a little clingy.
Keep giving me lots of affection from now on, okay？
(▲小早川＊▲ is even more forward than usual...)
